name: Read Yi Peng 3's AIS silences on the signal strip and over the timeline (signed in)
description: Validates the AIS signal strip: Yi Peng 3's 114 recorded reports, its silences of 15, 15 and 50 minutes, the reconstructed stretch before the first report, and the same strip over the timeline when the scrubber has keyboard focus.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-ship-02+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/yi-peng-3-2024?t=2024-11-18T07:00Z&mode=ship and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the card "AIS signal" (data-testid ais-signal) has data-state "recorded", data-report-count "114" and data-gap-minutes "15,15,50", and its header reads "18 Nov 06:00 to 11:00 UTC"
Move the mouse over the middle of the replay timeline (the track under the replay clock, data-testid replay-scrubber) and keep it there, without clicking

Assert a panel with data-testid timeline-ais-hover is shown above the timeline, with a data-state of report, gap, reconstructed or no-position, and its text includes "UTC" and one of "AIS, last report at", "no report for", "reconstructed position, placed from statements" or "no position for the ship"
